official_contract.pagination: The current official contract explicitly permits limit/offset pagination and requires looping to retrieve all rows.

legacy_unpaged_single_stock_probe.interpretation: The 5000-row response conflicts with the documented 3000-row page size and cannot establish completeness or a runtime cap; production must request and verify explicit 3000-row pages.

alternative_rejections.forecast_express: Accessible and PIT-date clean, but retained only as event anchors after the standalone event mechanism failed its frozen selection gates.
alternative_rejections.hk_hold: Actual responses contained no SH or SZ rows from 2024-08-19 onward; only HK rows remained.
alternative_rejections.fund_portfolio: A 2023-12-31 request returned exactly 8000 rows and only 104 funds, so it was incomplete without further partitioning and is only quarterly.

historical_vintage_limitation.evidence: The 2017 and 2020 probes were first created by the vendor 1831 and 732 calendar days later, so report_date alone cannot prove the historical EPS/NP values were never backfilled or revised.
historical_vintage_limitation.required_resolution: Before opening returns, validate a stratified sample against original research reports/research_report timestamps and values, or limit strict evidence to observations after first capture.

conclusion: The evidence establishes endpoint feasibility and a conservative report_date availability convention only. It does not establish historical vendor vintage, qualified three-broker feature coverage or profitable returns.
